question: Should Crabline enforce digest-only Docker action references and Python 3.10 as the minimum autoreview runtime in this security-policy change?
rationale: These choices deliberately tighten accepted automation inputs and supported tooling environments, so tests cannot determine the intended compatibility and security boundary.

options.title: Approve both boundaries
options.body: Accept digest-only Docker actions and Python 3.10 as intentional repository policy, then merge after conflict resolution and changelog cleanup.

options.title: Separate the Python floor
options.body: Land the action-security enforcement independently and move the Python 3.10 support decision into a narrowly documented follow-up.

options.title: Preserve current compatibility
options.body: Keep broader Python 3 support and limit this PR to ownership, CodeQL coverage, and immutable action-reference enforcement.

recommendation.title: Separate the Python floor
recommendation.body: Land the action-security enforcement independently and move the Python 3.10 support decision into a narrowly documented follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected security and automation paths are explicitly assigned to this team in CODEOWNERS.
